limitations: Only the signed rook monoid with entries ±1 and odd-characteristic/integer anticommutation is covered; not arbitrary scalars, characteristic two, or higher anticommuting tuple arity. General signed-monomial Clifford representation theory may contain a broader result. Publication priority is provisional.
scientific_integrity: The general proof reduces anticommutation to invariant active-support components and enumerates all signed singleton, two-point and four-point transitive blocks; finite direct signed-matrix censuses are corroborative rather than an infinite proof.
title: Exact anticommuting-pair enumerator for signed partial involutions
